reviews.comment: She really is a nice lady, but I couldn't tell you a single thing from that class. I showed up to every class and was constantly confused. Everyone in the AGEC 105 GroupMe from that class was also always very confused. She would assign projects on stuff she didn't even teach. Often had to move assignments back because of so many student emails.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Shcherbakova is a nice lady, but at times lectures or assignments can be confusing. Taking econ before this class would definitely be beneficial. Not necessarily a hard class overall, with only a weekly assignment and 2 exams being the material consisted in it. Exams were challenging though.

No exams, only group homework assignments. If you pay attention in class and get a good group then this is a really easy course. Only one 4-5 question assignment every week. She makes economics easy to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Anastasia is such a kind person and you can tells she truly cares about you and what she is teaching. With this being said he content can be very confusing, during lectures she kinda goes off into many different things making it hard to pay attention. Luckily I was not graded off of Test but instead group work, which makes it seem like less stress.

She is very sweet but does get somewhat confused during class sometimes with what she is trying to explain. The material is somewhat hard to understand but thankfully there are no tests. Your grade is off of participation in answering polls in class and group assignments outside of class.
She is honestly great. She does confuse herself during class though. 30% of our grade was showing up to class. I definitely would take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: Please ignore all of the bad reviews, she is a wonderful professor. She is so sweet, and is really understanding. The class is tough, and I did not get the best grades on the exams, but the curve at the end brought me up two letter grades. As long as you somewhat understand and ask questions you will pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A truly great professor. Classwork and exams are hard, and even with having taken ECON202 it was hard to get full credit on homework, but she has a really big curve at the end based on the average class grade. As long as you stay 5+ points above that you get an A (Spring 2020, a 70 was an A). Super sweet prof, wants to help you all she can.

This class made me change my major. She is a very sweet lady and is all willing to help. I went to office hours almost every week and still failed every test. This is not an impossible class, but if you have no background in economics I would not take her. My friend took it at blinn and had a much better experiance.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I thought she was a really great professor, even if the course was difficult. Shes definitely willing to work with you, but dont expect a free A. Her quizzes count a lot towards your final grade, so you have to stay on top of the material. She ended up curving the class.

She is a super sweet professor and always wants to help her students. She is very willing to meet during office hours or outside of class. The material is difficult but reading the book helps and she will gladly help each student understand the content. Attendance is not mandatory but there are weekly quizzes (usually done with partners).
Quizzes every other class over textbook reading and lecture. Tests are hard. Do not take her if you don't already have some knowledge of economics
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Anastasia is a very nice woman and a wonderful person, but she is a terrible professor. Half of the time she doesn't know what she's teaching or how to properly explain and confuses students further. Quizzes every other class over textbook chapters. If you don't know anything about economics and need a good grade in this class do not take her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy
